readerCopy.body: A big claim can sound convincing until the details left out of the headline have to answer for themselves. When Mercury opposes Jupiter, information and expansion pull against each other, creating tension between the inspiring big picture and the facts that complicate it. An ambitious promise can be broadly right and still be much less simple than advertised. The strongest version of the idea is the one that can survive questions about dates, numbers, responsibilities, and the actual plan.
